## 8. Pensionary terms for Central Government Employees absorbed consequent on conversion of Departments into Autonomous Body or a PSU  
[ Swamy's Pension Compilation]  
1. All Government servants of the concerned Department will be transferred en masse to the PSU / AB on terms of foreign service without any Deputation Allowance till such time they get absorbed in the said PSU / AB. The absorption will be from such date as may be notified by the Government.
